title: Saudi Lamb Skewers
description: A traditional Middle Eastern dish made with marinated lamb, perfect for grilling. Serve with a side of couscous or rice.

ingredients.name: vibrant
ingredients.notes: Vibrant spice blend or a mix of cumin, coriander, and paprika

ingredients.name: saudi
ingredients.notes: Saudi spice blend or a mix of cinnamon, allspice, and cardamom

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb to the marinade and mix well to coat.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
Thread the marinated lamb onto the skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
Brush the skewers with the remaining marinade and season with vibrant spice blend and saudi spice blend.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until cooked to your desired level of doneness.
Let the skewers rest for 5 minutes before serving.
